title: 倒墙后的担架
text: 两名随军医工把担架架在倒墙后。水壶在小炉上冒着热气，绷带按干净和用过分成两堆。“坐下就慢慢处理；若赶时间，我们还有一份现成的。”

texts.en: Two Legion orderlies have set their stretchers up behind a fallen wall. A kettle steams on a small stove; the bandages are sorted into clean and used. "Sit down and we'll do it properly. If you're in a hurry, we have one dressing ready."

options.label: 坐下处理伤处（倒计时 −{pass_time_actions}，体力 +{restore_vitality_amount}）

outcomes.text: 绷带重新收紧，你起身时脚下稳了些。炉里的水已经烧开。

texts.en: The bandages are pulled tight again, and you stand a little steadier. The water on the stove has come to the boil.

labels.en: Pay for a quick dressing ({change_money_amount|abs}, Vitality +{restore_vitality_amount})

outcomes.text: 医工拆开预备好的敷料，很快处理完伤处。

texts.en: An orderly unwraps the ready dressing and is done in moments.
